## Featured Projects
- **Chatbot AI (Aksara AI)**: Intelligent conversational AI with natural language processing built with Python, Flask, Firebase, and JavaScript. (https://aksara-ai.vercel.app)
- **Waste Classifier**: AI-powered waste classification application using deep learning models built with React, Tailwind CSS, Python, TensorFlow, and Keras. (https://waste-classifier-v1.vercel.app)
- **NutriSuggest**: Health and nutrition food recommendation web platform using React, TypeScript, Python, and Flask. (https://nutrisuggest.vercel.app)
- **Thrift Haven**: E-commerce marketplace for second-hand items built with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Firebase. (https://thrifting-haven.vercel.app)
- **Simpan Cepat**: AI-powered note-taking and productivity app built with Next.js, Firebase, TypeScript, and Google Genkit.
- **Smart Attendance**: Face-recognition attendance marking system built with Python, OpenCV, Flask, and React.
